top_signals.title: The 1982 War Still Haunts the Middle East
top_signals.summary: Journalist and author Kim Ghattas tells Bloomberg This Weekend how the violence that engulfed Lebanon in 1982 helped set the US, Israel, Iran and the wider Middle East on a trajectory that continues to shape conflicts in the region today. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini about her new book, The Best Kind of American, Ghattas examines Hezbollah’s enduring influence, Lebanon’s struggle to assert state authority and the risks of trying to remake the region through war. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Is Moving to Restaurants
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Pursuits Food Editor Kate Krader tells Bloomberg This Weekend that more Americans are choosing restaurants for Thanksgiving as higher grocery costs, cooking stress and cleanup make dining out increasingly attractive. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Krader explains how restaurants are responding with traditional feasts and unconventional menus as Thanksgiving reservations continue to rise. (Source: Bloomberg)
